contract.title: Q0 execution replay gate cold-start review
contract.goal: Review commit ffb1d5d17e9078e206228268e080102d5140eb25 read-only. Determine whether q0_replay_expected/q0_execution_audit and verify_q0_replay correctly distinguish plan insertion from real service start, preserve atomicity, avoid false positives across repeated packet actions, and export sufficient evidence. Also check that the Q0-I tiny DP remains explicitly bounded and does not masquerade as Q0-F. Return APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES. Every finding must cite path and line range, distinguish FACT/INFERENCE/UNVERIFIED, and state whether it blocks using this gate as a first-stage Q0 execution check. Do not modify code.
requiredEvidence: Exact file paths and line references
